required.name: title
required.label: Service name
required.why: The agent has to name the service to match it against the job the user described.

required.name: price
required.label: Price
required.why: The agent needs a number, a range, or an explicit "no published price" — silence it has to read as unaffordable.

required.name: primary-action-url
required.label: Booking or enquiry link
required.why: Gives the agent one link to hand over when the user commits, instead of a form it has to go hunting for.

recommended.name: duration
recommended.label: Duration
recommended.why: Lets the agent check the service against the time the user actually has.

recommended.name: eligibility
recommended.label: Eligibility
recommended.why: Stops the agent recommending something the user cannot qualify for, which is worse than recommending nothing.

recommended.name: service-area
recommended.label: Service area
recommended.why: Tells the agent whether the user's location is somewhere this service is offered at all.

recommended.name: description
recommended.label: Description
recommended.why: Gives the agent your own account of what is included, so it does not infer the scope from the price.

recommended.name: updated
recommended.label: Last updated
recommended.why: Tells the agent how much to trust a price and a scope that may have moved since they were written.
